item.title: Vehicle repairs and Sales, 12th August
item.description:
Formal complaint regarding ongoing vehicle repair and apparent vehicle sales activities being carried out on the roadside by an individual who resides at 71 Slade Green Road. I understand that this individual is renting a room at the property and is not the property owner. He continues to use the roadside and surrounding residential area to carry out vehicle repairs and apparent vehicle trading/sales activities. Vehicle currently being repaired is a range rover reg: LX12KYE This is not an isolated incident. The activity has been taking place repeatedly and has previously been reported to the Council. I understand that multiple warnings have already been issued by the Council, yet the individual continues with the same activities despite these interventions. The continued use of a residential street and public roadside for vehicle repairs and apparent commercial vehicle trading is causing concern to local residents. It also raises concerns regarding obstruction of the highway, inappropriate commercial use of a residential area, environmental impact, and whether the necessary permissions or licences are in place.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Newham Way, Slade Green, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
